rich_ore_vein.name: Rich Ore Vein
rich_ore_vein.description: A rare asteroid veined with concentrated ore - stands out from the drab rock around it with a brighter, warmer color, and pays out far more per hit than an ordinary rock.

lone_pirate.name: Lone Pirate
lone_pirate.description: A single raider shadowing traffic at the edge of scanner range, hoping to shake down anyone who strays too far from help. Demands tribute over comms before attacking - hail back to pay it off, refuse, or just outrun the clock.
